#SHAP dependence plots demonstrate the relationships between any chosen feature and the target variable.

![](bbox=[0.15, 0.15, 0.6, 0.44])

```
shap.initjs()
def p(j):
    explainer = shap.TreeExplainer(RF)
    RF_shap_values = explainer.shap_values(x_test)
    return (shap.force_plot(explainer.expected_value, RF_shap_values[j,:],
        x_test.iloc[j,:]))
p (0)
```

#Force plot generated by SHAP shows how each feature contributes negatively or positively to the prediction.

```
shap.plots.bar(RF_binary_shap_values[0])
```
